description: Per-country comparison of the national statistics shown on Apprentix: what each one counts. Written from the connectors' definitions and the publishers' documentation; reviewed 2026-10-17.

CH.summary: All five Swiss series include full-time school-based VET unless the 'Dual' training form is selected; the learner stock comes from two BFS surveys (school year vs calendar year) that differ slightly. Eurostat's ED3SW proxy (pupils in combined school- and work-based programmes) is lower than the BFS learner stock, which also includes school-based VET.

series.label: Learners in initial VET (school year)
series.covers: All learners in upper-secondary initial VET: EFZ, EBA, non-regulated, HMS/IMS (to 2013), Anlehre; dual and school-based
series.excludes: Not split by training form; tertiary-level (higher VET) programmes
series.use_when: Use this for the longest learner series (from 1999/2000), by programme type.

series.label: Learners in initial VET by dual/school-based form
series.covers: Learners in EFZ, EBA and non-regulated initial VET, split into dual (company) and full-time school-based
series.excludes: Training form not recorded in 2005–2006
series.use_when: Use this for the number of learners in dual (company-based) training.

series.label: Learners in initial VET by canton
series.covers: Same learners as the training-form series, by canton of the training company; 'CH' = national total
series.excludes: not stated
series.use_when: Use this for comparing cantons; the national total equals the training-form series.

series.label: Entrants to initial VET
series.covers: People entering EFZ, EBA or non-regulated initial VET in the year, dual and school-based
series.excludes: Learners continuing from earlier years
series.use_when: Use this for new starts; with 'Dual' selected, the nearest to new contracts.

series.label: Initial VET qualifications awarded
series.covers: Successful qualification procedures (EFZ, EBA, non-regulated), incl. candidates without a contract
series.excludes: Failed qualification procedures
series.use_when: Use this for completions (qualifications awarded), not learners.

DE.summary: Destatis counts dual training contracts under BBiG/HwO (stock at 31 December, new contracts and passed exams in the calendar year); the BA figures cover only places and applicants registered with the employment agencies in the October–September reporting year. Eurostat splits German dual training between upper-secondary (ED3SW) and post-secondary (ED4SW) levels, so ED3SW alone is well below the Destatis stock.

series.label: Apprentices in dual training
series.covers: Dual training contracts under BBiG and the Crafts Code (HwO), by training area; counts contracts, not persons
series.excludes: School-based VET (e.g. health and care schools, Berufsfachschulen)
series.use_when: Use this for the number of apprentices in dual training in Germany.

series.label: Apprentices in dual training by Land
series.covers: Same scope as the national stock (BBiG/HwO dual training), by Land of the training place and sex
series.excludes: School-based VET (e.g. health and care schools, Berufsfachschulen)
series.use_when: Use this for comparing Länder; the 'DE' total is close to the national series.

series.label: Registered training places still unfilled
series.covers: Places registered with employment agencies/job centres that still had no apprentice at 30 September
series.excludes: Places never registered with the employment agencies (registration is voluntary)
series.use_when: Use this for employers' difficulty in filling places.

series.label: Registered applicants still unplaced
series.covers: Registered applicants with neither a training place nor an alternative, still looking at 30 September
series.excludes: Applicants with an alternative (school, course, job) who still want a place; unregistered seekers
series.use_when: Use this for young people left without a training place.

series.label: Newly concluded training contracts
series.covers: Dual training contracts (BBiG/HwO) concluded in the year, as recorded by the competent bodies
series.excludes: School-based VET; BIBB's 30 September new-contract count is a separate, different figure
series.use_when: Use this for new apprenticeship contracts in Germany.

series.label: Final apprenticeship examinations passed
series.covers: Final exams passed in BBiG/HwO dual training, incl. external candidates without a training contract
series.excludes: Failed examinations; school-based VET
series.use_when: Use this for completions of dual training.

series.label: Training places registered with employment agencies
series.reference: reporting year Oct–Sep, totals at 30 Sep (2025 = 2024/25)
series.covers: Company training places in BBiG/HwO occupations that employers registered for placement in the year
series.excludes: Places not registered (registration is voluntary); not all apprenticeship places
series.use_when: Use this for registered demand for apprentices, not total places.

series.label: Applicants registered with employment agencies
series.reference: reporting year Oct–Sep, totals at 30 Sep (2025 = 2024/25)
series.covers: Young people who used the agencies' and job centres' placement service to seek a training place
series.excludes: Applicants who did not register (registration is voluntary)
series.use_when: Use this for registered demand for training places, not all applicants.

DK.summary: Denmark's only national series is a monthly flow of new training agreements in vocational education (EUD), not a count of apprentices in training. Eurostat's ED3SW is a stock of pupils, so the two measure different things.

series.label: New training agreements (monthly)
series.covers: Agreements concluded between an EUD student and an approved company: ordinary, short, rest and combination
series.excludes: Apprentices already in training (stock); higher-education apprenticeships; small cells suppressed
series.use_when: Use this for monthly trends in new agreements; compare the same month across years.

FI.summary: Finnish figures count students and qualifications whose studies included at least one apprenticeship period, across initial, further and specialist qualifications, many taken by adults; they are not counts of contracts. Eurostat's ED3SW proxy is lower than the national student count, which covers anyone studying at any time in the calendar year.

series.label: New vocational students with apprenticeship periods
series.covers: Students starting vocational education in the year whose studies included an apprenticeship period
series.excludes: Students with no apprenticeship period; higher-education apprenticeships
series.use_when: Use this for people starting vocational studies that include apprenticeship.

series.label: Vocational qualifications with apprenticeship periods
series.covers: Initial, further and specialist vocational qualifications completed after studies with an apprenticeship period
series.excludes: Qualifications with no apprenticeship period; higher-education apprenticeships
series.use_when: Use this for completions involving apprenticeship training.

series.label: Vocational students with apprenticeship periods
series.reference: calendar year (anyone studying at any time in the year)
series.covers: Students in initial, further or specialist vocational qualifications with at least one apprenticeship period
series.excludes: Students with no apprenticeship period; higher-education apprenticeships
series.use_when: Use this for the number of people learning through apprenticeship during a year.

FR.summary: Both French series cover all apprenticeship contracts, including the large share preparing higher-education diplomas, which most other countries' counts and Eurostat's upper-secondary ED3SW proxy do not include. One series is an end-of-month stock, the other a monthly flow of new contracts; both are seasonal, peaking in September.

series.label: Apprentices under contract (end of month)
series.covers: All current apprenticeship contracts, private and public employers, secondary and higher-education levels, incl. DROM
series.excludes: Overseas collectivities (COM)
series.use_when: Use this for the number of apprentices in France at a given date.

series.label: New apprenticeship contracts (monthly)
series.covers: New contracts by start month, incl. renewals, private and public employers, all diploma levels, incl. DROM
series.excludes: Overseas collectivities (COM)
series.use_when: Use this for new apprenticeship contracts; compare the same month across years.

IE.summary: Ireland's national figures are completions (apprentices qualifying each year) and their later employment, not registrations or a stock of apprentices in training. They include consortia-led apprenticeships up to NFQ level 8, whereas Eurostat's ED3SW is an upper-secondary enrolment proxy.

series.label: Apprentices qualifying
series.covers: Apprentices who qualified: craft (NFQ 6) and consortia-led (NFQ 5–8) programmes; rounded to nearest 5
series.excludes: Registrations and apprentices still in training
series.use_when: Use this for apprenticeship completions in Ireland.

series.label: Qualified apprentices in employment
series.reference: qualification year; default 2 years after qualifying
series.covers: Share of a qualifying cohort in employment (with or without study), from administrative (Revenue) records
series.excludes: Records with missing or invalid PPSN; 'not captured' outcomes stay in the denominator
series.use_when: Use this for employment outcomes of apprentices after qualifying.

NL.summary: Both Dutch series count students enrolled in MBO at 1 October; BBL is the work-based pathway, not a count of apprenticeship contracts, and the two BBL totals differ slightly because of disclosure control. Eurostat's ED3SW series for the Netherlands on the site ends in 2010.

series.label: MBO students by learning pathway (default: BBL)
series.covers: Main enrolments in MBO by pathway: BBL, BOL full-time, BOL part-time, exam-only; funded and non-funded
series.excludes: Higher-education apprenticeships; cells of 1–4 students suppressed
series.use_when: Use this for comparing work-based (BBL) with school-based (BOL) MBO.

series.label: BBL students by level and sector
series.covers: Main BBL enrolments in MBO levels 1–4, by level and sector chamber; funded and non-funded
series.excludes: Other MBO pathways; suppressed cells (total up to ~0.5% below the pathway series)
series.use_when: Use this for BBL by level or sector chamber.

NO.summary: Norway's figures separate the stock of apprentices at 1 October, new apprentices in the year and trade/journeyman examinations; all are upper-secondary only. Eurostat's ED3SW figure for Norway is about twice the SSB apprentice count and is flagged 'definition differs'.

series.label: Apprentices (default; training candidates optional)
series.covers: Persons registered as apprentices in upper secondary; training candidates available as a separate type
series.excludes: Training candidates in the default view; higher-education apprenticeships
series.use_when: Use this for the number of apprentices in Norway at a date.

series.label: New apprentices
series.covers: Apprentices registered as new in the year, all ages (sum of SSB age groups), whole country
series.excludes: Training candidates; continuing apprentices
series.use_when: Use this for apprenticeship entries; do not add to the stock series.

series.label: Trade/journeyman exams sat (default: apprentices)
series.covers: Persons sitting the trade or journeyman's examination; default = apprentices, all results
series.excludes: Practice candidates and pupils in the default view; failed exams are included unless 'Passed' is chosen
series.use_when: Use this for apprentices reaching the final examination.

UK.summary: All three series cover England only and count programmes or learners by academic year (August–July), including higher and degree apprenticeships; starts and achievements are flows, participation counts anyone on an apprenticeship during the year. Eurostat's ED3SW series for the UK on the site ends in 2019.

series.label: Apprenticeship starts (England)
series.reference: academic year Aug–Jul; time = start year (2024 = 2024/25)
series.covers: Programme starts at all levels (2 to 7, incl. degree apprenticeships), ages 16+; a learner can start twice
series.excludes: Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland
series.use_when: Use this for new apprenticeships in England.

series.label: Apprenticeship achievements (England)
series.reference: academic year Aug–Jul; time = start year (2024 = 2024/25)
series.covers: Programmes successfully completed at all levels (2 to 7), ages 16+; rounded to nearest 10
series.excludes: Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland; programmes not completed
series.use_when: Use this for completions of apprenticeships in England.

series.label: Apprenticeship participation (England)
series.reference: academic year Aug–Jul (anyone on an apprenticeship during the year)
series.covers: Learners on an apprenticeship at any point in the year, all levels (2 to 7), ages 16+
series.excludes: Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland; not a point-in-time stock
series.use_when: Use this for how many people were apprentices in England during a year.
